_comment: Reference data points transcribed from the published MERP attack tables
(AT-1 through AT-6), used to validate the d20 re-fit in
MERP tables are d100-based, rows 01-150. The d20 re-fit maps MERP roll -> net
roll as net_roll = merp_roll / 5, so the final table row (146-150) corresponds
to net roll 30. 'max_hits' below is the damage value in that final row.
MERP has FIVE armour columns: Plate, Chain, Leather-Rigid, Leather-Soft, None.
The engine models FOUR (Plate, Chain, Leather, None), collapsing the two leather
columns. The collapse used is the arithmetic mean of rigid and soft; see
docs/adr/0004-armour-column-collapse.md. Both source columns are retained here so
the collapse can be revisited without re-reading the books.
AT-7 and AT-8 are validated across their usable ranges by
docs/reference/merp-attack-tables.csv. They remain excluded from this final-row
check because AT-8 has no regular row at net roll 30 after open-ended-up is removed.
environmental_fall_crush still has no supplied source table and is not validated.
Critical thresholds (base_crit_a, crit_interval) are NOT validated here. Only the
damage curve is. Transcribing first-crit rows from the supplied images was not
reliable enough to assert; add them when the books are to hand.
